Architecture

Source-to-target migration

The old offline platformer is historical evidence for documentation rigor, not the new MMO specification.

Inspected source

Reference main was inspected at 6633ca27f7b2fcfc80fc95a1567e97c0eb5a6a25. Read AGENTS.md, architecture.html and early phase-integration records; inspected repository metadata/tree. The full 163-asset legacy catalog and every engineering chapter were not individually reviewed. A container clone failed because DNS was unavailable; connector reads succeeded.

Retain the original revision in Git history/backup branch rather than copying old gameplay pages into active navigation. This edition rewrites the architecture and phase order; legacy identifiers are not aliases that silently continue local-save rules.

Retained principles

Definitions remain immutable; UI observes; a persistent identity is not an immortal Actor; one owner changes each fact; rewards must be replay-safe. What changes is the authority/durability implementation, not those invariants. Preserve the old create/configure/integrate/world/run/reject/regress discipline.

Publication instruction resolution

The master prompt initially defaults to a new ZIP/repository and prohibits overwriting, but its final direct instruction requests overwrite of game_docs. This edition interprets that final instruction as authority for a normal replacement commit, preserving prior history and a backup revision; no force push, repository rename or deletion. Actual publication result is recorded in sources/verification.json.

Evidence and external references

External links need internet; the manual itself remains offline. Public documentation does not prove installed compatibility.

  • Reference documentation workflow — Read through authenticated GitHub connector; source records, generated integration and honest runtime evidence retained as concepts.
  • Reference architecture — Read through GitHub connector; local Profile/WorldState/GameInstance/SaveGame ownership superseded by this guide.
  • Reference phase integration — Inspected beginning of record (phases 0–2), including X/Z constraint, axis1D input and integration sequence. Full historical repository not cloned.
  • Networked Character Movement — Public 5.8 description checked: saved moves, server corrections and simulated proxy smoothing. Custom sprint/dodge integration still requires installed-source and runtime verification.
  • Travelling in multiplayer — Public 5.8 documentation checked; distinguish individual ClientTravel, whole-world ServerTravel and level streaming.
